name: 62626 · Carlinville, IL
findings: ZIP 62626 (Carlinville) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62626 (Carlinville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
54% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62626 (Carlinville) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).
